ضَلِعٌ Crooked, or curved, by nature. (S, O, TA.) And applied to a spear as meaning Crooked, or curved; not straightened: (TA:) or, so applied, inclining, or bending: (Ham p. 80:) and ↓ ضَلِيعٌ and ↓ ضَالِعٌ , so applied,
[likewise] mean crooked, or curved. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also 1, in the last quarter of the paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
